lines.en: I drop by the cafe to hang out with Haruka but, when I arrive, she’s surprised to see that I approach {i}her{/i} instead of her much younger and much more lesbian employee.
lines.zh: 我去咖啡馆找 Haruka 玩，可等我到了，她看到我径直走向{i}她{/i}、而不是走向她那位更年轻也更百合的员工，显得有些意外。

lines.en: I can't blame her, though. Especially when I know she probably wants to fuck her even more than I do. But I draw no attention to this as that would be rude.
lines.zh: 不过我不怪她。尤其是我知道，她想上那姑娘的心思搞不好比我还甚。但我没有点破，那太失礼了。

lines.en: Instead, I listen to the two of them argue about some inventory-related issues that I can't be bothered to care about when my mind is already flooded with sex and squalor.
lines.zh: 于是我听着她们俩为一些库存相关的问题争来争去——我脑子里已经塞满了性爱与龌龊，实在懒得关心那些。

lines.en: Eventually, I'm able to order a drink. Hooray. And I spend the next few minutes mandatorily involving myself in Haruka's affairs while Rin makes it.
lines.zh: 最后我总算点上了饮品。万岁。Rin 做饮品的那几分钟里，我被迫掺和进了 Haruka 的店里事务。

lines.en: She asks me if I'll be taking it for here or to go. And I instinctively say “here” but I immediately regret it as I take a seat at a nearby table.
lines.zh: 她问我是堂食还是外带。我下意识说了「堂食」，可一在旁边的桌子坐下就立刻后悔了。

lines.en: You see, I've never felt {i}comfortable{/i} in crowds. I don't like being the center of attention and I'm always worried that someone is going to talk to me.
lines.zh: 你看，我从来就{i}不擅长{/i}待在人群里。我不喜欢成为焦点，还总担心会有人来跟我搭话。

lines.en: Which means I must be a masochist as I keep throwing myself headfirst into situations where that's bound to happen.
lines.zh: 这说明我一定是个受虐狂，因为我总是把自己一头栽进注定会发生那种事的场合里。

lines.en: Someone asks me for the time. But I don't know the time. It's just {i}now.{/i} So I tell them it's {i}now{/i} and they get mad.
lines.zh: 有人问我几点了。可我不知道几点。就是{i}现在{/i}。于是我告诉他们现在是{i}现在{/i}，然后他们生气了。

lines.en: Haruka comes to drop off my drink, but brings the actual answer to the person's question along with her.
lines.zh: Haruka 过来送我的饮品，顺带着把那个人问题的真正答案也带来了。

lines.en: She scolds me for messing with her customers. But what she doesn't know is I'm being more genuine now than ever before.
lines.zh: 她怪我捉弄她的客人。可她不知道的是，此刻的我比以往任何时候都要真诚。
